title: Redraw Play Start Camera No Snap
description: On redraw play start remove snap to triptych; init chase ref from current baseline mirror so damping interpolates from visible camera.
summary: Play start no longer calls setBoardPlayPaneCamerasBaseline(triptych(fixture)) which snapped all panes. Added boardPlayPaneCamerasBaselineMirrorRef synced each render; playJustStarted seeds boardPlayRedrawCameraChaseRef from mirror (current view). Chase effect then damps toward triptych on fixture ticks. Settings blurb updated. Vitest: 59 passed, 1 unrelated flaky WASM link test failed on index.ts.
